1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.HingeDeterminant
2 
3 /-! Two explicit generating rays suffice for the opposite-petal cone comparisons. -/
4 
5 namespace SixVertexUnfolding
6 
7 /-- The closed cone of nonnegative combinations of two planar vectors. -/
8 def twoRayCone (e f : Plane) : Set Plane :=
9   {x | ∃ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a ∧ 0 ≤ b ∧ x = a • e + b • f}
10 
11 /-- Its translate at an apex. -/
12 def translatedCone (p e f : Plane) : Set Plane := {x | x - p ∈ twoRayCone e f}
13 
14 theorem twoRayCone_convex (e f : Plane) : Convex ℝ (twoRayCone e f) := by
15   rintro x ⟨a, b, ha, hb, rfl⟩ y ⟨c, d, hc, hd, rfl⟩ s t hs ht total
16   refine ⟨s * a + t * c, s * b + t * d,
17     add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hs ha) (mul_nonneg ht hc),
18     add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hs hb) (mul_nonneg ht hd), ?_⟩
19   module
20 
21 theorem zero_mem_twoRayCone (e f : Plane) : (0 : Plane) ∈ twoRayCone e f :=
22   ⟨0, 0, le_rfl, le_rfl, by simp⟩
23 
24 /-- Nonparallel generating rays have unique coefficients. -/
25 theorem twoRay_coefficients_unique (e f : Plane) (independent : det e f ≠ 0)
26     (a b c d : ℝ) (equal : a • e + b • f = c • e + d • f) : a = c ∧ b = d := by
27   have along_e := congrArg (fun x => det e x) equal
28   have along_f := congrArg (fun x => det f x) equal
29   simp only [det_add_right, det_smul_right, det_self, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero] at along_e along_f
30   have reverse_ne : det f e ≠ 0 := by rw [det_swap]; exact neg_ne_zero.mpr independent
31   have first_product : (a - c) * det f e = 0 := by nlinarith
32   have second_product : (b - d) * det e f = 0 := by nlinarith
33   exact ⟨sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp first_product).resolve_right reverse_ne),
34     sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp second_product).resolve_right independent)⟩
35 
36 /-- Two cones pointing toward each other cannot meet when the displacement has negative total coefficients. -/
37 theorem opposed_cones_disjoint_of_sum (p q e f : Plane) (independent : det e f ≠ 0)
38     (a b : ℝ) (displacement : q - p = a • e + b • f) (negative_sum : a + b < 0) :
39     Disjoint (translatedCone p e f) (translatedCone q (-e) (-f)) := by
40   apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
41   rintro x ⟨s, t, hs, ht, left⟩ ⟨u, v, hu, hv, right⟩
42   have combination : q - p = (s + u) • e + (t + v) • f := by
43     calc
44       q - p = (x - p) - (x - q) := by module
45       _ = (s + u) • e + (t + v) • f := by rw [left, right]; module
46   have coefficients := twoRay_coefficients_unique e f independent a b (s + u) (t + v)
47     (displacement.symm.trans combination)
48   obtain ⟨first, second⟩ := coefficients
49   linarith
50 
51 /-- This is the strict distance-sum contradiction in the first opposite-petal case. -/
52 theorem opposed_cones_disjoint_of_lengths (p q e f : Plane) (independent : det e f ≠ 0)
53     (s t L R : ℝ) (displacement : q - p = (s - L) • e + (t - R) • f)
54     (shorter : s + t < L + R) : Disjoint (translatedCone p e f) (translatedCone q (-e) (-f)) :=
55   opposed_cones_disjoint_of_sum p q e f independent (s - L) (t - R) displacement (by linarith)
56 
57 theorem mem_twoRayCone_iff_dets (e f x : Plane) (positive : 0 < det e f) :
58     x ∈ twoRayCone e f ↔ 0 ≤ det e x ∧ 0 ≤ det x f := by
59   constructor
60   · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, rfl⟩
61     constructor
62     · rw [det_add_right, det_smul_right, det_smul_right, det_self, mul_zero, zero_add]
63       exact mul_nonneg hb positive.le
64     · rw [det_add_left, det_smul_left, det_smul_left, det_self, mul_zero, add_zero]
65       exact mul_nonneg ha positive.le
66   · rintro ⟨left, right⟩
67     refine ⟨det x f / det e f, det e x / det e f, div_nonneg right positive.le, div_nonneg left positive.le, ?_⟩
68     ext i
69     fin_cases i <;> simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
70     · change x 0 = det x f / det e f * e 0 + det e x / det e f * f 0
71       field_simp [positive.ne']
72       simp only [det]
73       ring
74     · change x 1 = det x f / det e f * e 1 + det e x / det e f * f 1
75       field_simp [positive.ne']
76       simp only [det]
77       ring
78 
79 /-- Every direction in a sector of width below pi belongs to the cone generated by its boundary rays. -/
80 theorem direction_mem_twoRayCone (α β θ : ℝ) (width_pos : 0 < β - α) (width_small : β - α < Real.pi)
81     (lower : α ≤ θ) (upper : θ ≤ β) : direction θ ∈ twoRayCone (direction α) (direction β) := by
82   apply (mem_twoRayCone_iff_dets _ _ _ (by rw [direction_det]; exact Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi width_pos width_small)).mpr
83   constructor <;> rw [direction_det] <;>
84     apply Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi <;> linarith
85 
86 end SixVertexUnfolding
